title: Texxon Holding Limited Announces Annual General Meeting
summary: Investors on record by April 23 can join the virtual May 22 meeting, where Texxon will also seek approval for a 2026 equity plan and auditor.
body_markdown:
On the day this news was published, **NPT** gained **8.74%** , reflecting a notable positive market reaction. Argus tracked a trough of **-64.5%** from its starting point during tracking. Our momentum scanner triggered **49 alerts** that day, indicating elevated trading interest and price volatility. This price movement added approximately **$7M** to the company's valuation, bringing the market cap to **$81.86M** at that time. Trading volume was elevated at **2.4x** the daily average, suggesting notable buying interest.
